messages:
anya: Hey team — prepping the inbound demo pack and we need a small set of visuals for the webinar + syndication. Quick brief below.
liam: 👍 can you drop the brief here?
natalie: Copying the high-level asks I promised on the briefing call.
anya: 1) One hero diagram that explains 'inference economics' simply for a 6-min talk slide. Needs to show latency vs. cost tradeoffs + 3 knobs (batching, quantization, KV cache). Not an infographic, more of a clean explainer.
liam: Got it — prefer a flow/stack style or a scatter with annotations?
anya: Flow/stack preferred, labels on each knob. Give me both 16:9 slide art and a tall 9:16 social cut.

2) Two benchmark cards (compact):
- Card A: latency-first profile (p95, tokens/sec, unit-cost callouts)
- Card B: cost-first profile (avg cost/token, throughput)
Keep the same baseline colors and an optional grayscale version for the partner one-sheet.

3) Webinar storyboard: 6 frames (title, problem, demo snapshot, cost/latency tradeoff, CTA, appendix). We just need simple annotated frames (no full animation).

4) Delivery + assets: source Figma + PNG exports (16:9@1440px, 1:1@1200px, 9:16@1080x1920), and an editable slide in Google Slides. Include alt text for accessibility.

5) Brand compliance check: use approved type scale and brand colors only. Colors: ```#00A3FF #0F172A #1A1A1A``` — avoid gradients for the hero diagram.

liam: Will do variants: slide + 1:1 + 9:16 + grayscale. ETA?
anya: Can we get first drafts by Tue EOD (PST)?
liam: Tight but doable. I'll push a framesheet early Mon for quick feedback.

kate: Heads up — we need a version with localized CTA copy for EU (German) and JP. Who owns copy?
natalie: I'll take EU/JP short CTAs and add to the drive folder: drive:redwood/marketing/launchsprint/inbound-pack/copy_locales.md

liam: Noted. Also need icons for batching/quantization/cache — do we have an icon set?
design-bot: @liam — there is an icon pack at drive:redwood/design/assets/iconset_v2.svg (use stroke 2).

anya: Small priority note: the hero diagram must be very legible at 600px width (we'll reuse for blog header). Keep text > 16px equivalent.

liam: OK, will keep all text scalable and share a single Figma file with pages: hero, benchmark-cards, storyboard, exports.

natalie: For the webinar slide deck I'll review flow and add speaker notes. Please add a callout layer with suggested talking points.

anya: Thanks — if you need copy tweaks ping me. Also please add a quick QA checklist in the Figma file for brand guardrail checks (font sizes, hex match, spacing).

liam: Will do. Tagging deliverables for clarity:
- Figma source + export pack (liam)
- PNG/Slides/alt text (liam)
- Localized CTAs (natalie)
- Brand QA checklist (liam + design-bot)
- Final upload to drive and attach to webinar invite (kate)

kate: I'll handle upload + invite asset attachment once exports are in. ETA for upload?
liam: I'll upload draft exports Tue morning, final Wed after feedback.

anya: Awesome — thanks all. Small ask: add two quick variants of the hero diagram that emphasize either "latency" or "cost" (for A/Bing the talk slide).

liam: Will create hero-x2 (latency-first / cost-first).

design-bot: Reminder: use font family 'Inter' (600 for headings) and follow the H2/H3 scale in /brand/typography.md.

anya: Perfect. I’ll check drafts Monday. :eyes:
